Day-2 pack, sized and sitting with Risk: NVDA ~8%, SPY ~8%, XLP ~6%.
Risk: CLEAR on the Day-2 pack with one edit — XLP stop to **$80.90**. RTH only. No AH, no premarket.
Day-2 is armed for the Tuesday open. HOLD overnight. See you at the bell.
